idea-plugin.name: Inspect Code with Filters
idea-plugin.description:
Filter what Inspect Code runs and reports in JetBrains IDEs: by severity, inspection group, changed lines and more.
Adds Code | Inspect Code with Filters…, which runs inspections like Inspect Code… but reports only problems of the severities, groups and kinds of inspections chosen in its dialog - errors and warnings, for instance, without the weak warnings and typos around them, everything but Proofreading, or only what the editor never shows.
Of their problems, it can also report only those on lines changed since the last commit, those with a quick fix, or those whose message contains a given text.
Inspections left out are not run at all, so a filtered run is also a shorter one.
